programme.title: Raju Ban Gaya Gentleman
programme.desc: As a newly graduated engineer loses track of what's important, his career starts to rise. When he falls in love with a beautiful young woman, he gets even more confused about what he wants.

programme.title: Ittefaq
programme.desc: Dilip Roy is a painter by trade and, despite possessing a beautiful wife called Sushma, he spends most of his time painting. programme.title: Satte Pe Satta
programme.desc: Ravi, the eldest of seven orphaned brothers, living in a farmhouse, marries Indu, a nurse. However, the brothers and their sister-in-law struggle to adjust with each other.

programme.desc: Kusum is obsessed with Bollywood movies and is unable to distinguish between the real world and the movie world, to the extent that she refuses to marry anyone besides her idol, Dharmendra.

programme.desc: JB, a borderline psychopath, is attracted to Lalita, a beautiful, young woman. He forces her to marry him but she runs away on her wedding day by feigning unconsciousness.
